assertions.detail: Both public discovery methods exclude the published, initially untrusted fixture issuer.
An encrypted settings PushDrop token was signed through public wallet methods and read back.
Waited for the native trust cache to expire without modifying its clock or private state.
The unchanged native wallet discovers the published fixture through both public methods after trust-cache expiry.
Restored the exact original settings; an originally absent token remains absent.
A serialized signed transaction spends the temporary trust token; it is absent from the restored basket.
All settings reads, writes, signatures and discovery calls use public wallet methods.
Durable temporary trust is retired; the enclosing isolated native container retires any residual in-memory cache.
